fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-04-08 at about 20:30, it was reported that items including jewellery kept in a cupboard were taken from an unattended premises at Anbu Puram Apartment Complex. The complaint was lodged by Deviga Devi (9000000460) on behalf of Gunasekar Prakash, whose contact number is given as 9000000443. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Madhan Murugan, using the number 9000000216. A witness, Vignesh Balan, reachable on 9000000105, was mentioned in the complaint. Karthik Rajan (9000000091), described as a friend of the suspect, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned a witness statement and CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Reported theft occurred while the residents were away for a few hours.
fields.Keywords: property theft, valuables, evening, associate, apartment complex, witness, mobile number, witness statement
